children: Sweden’s Swedbank Manufacturing PMI rose to 56.1 in August 2026 from a revised 55.7 in July, remaining above its long-term average of 54.3 and signaling continued expansion.
The improvement was supported by stronger production (58.9 vs 57.2 in July) and employment (57.6 vs 56.0), while order intake eased to 54.6 from 56.7.
Suppliers’ delivery times shortened to 59.8 from 60.1, while inventories declined to 55.5 from 58.1.
Export orders fell to 51.7 from 54.1, while domestic orders edged up to 54.7 from 54.2.
On the price front, the index for suppliers’ raw material and input prices jumped to 75.4 from 67.1, pointing to renewed cost pressures.
Meanwhile, the production plans index increased to 66.9 from 65.8, although it remained below the 70 threshold, indicating cautious optimism.

title: Sweden Manufacturing Growth Rises in August
